task.title: A to-do list that is saved
task.html:
To-do list

No tasks yet
task.description: Make a to-do list. loadTodos() reads an array of strings from localStorage under the key "todos" with JSON.parse inside try / catch; no data or broken data - an empty array. renderTodos() outputs each task as li.todo with span.todo__title and a button.todo__delete "Delete"; #todo-empty is visible only when there are no tasks. Submitting #todo-form without a reload: the #todo-input value after trim(); empty - the text "Enter a task" in #todo-error, the error is visible, the field has aria-invalid="true"; otherwise the task is added and saved with JSON.stringify, the field is cleared, the error is hidden and aria-invalid is removed. One handler on #todo-list deletes a task by its button from the list and from localStorage.

tests.name: Start: no tasks, "No tasks yet" is visible
tests.fail: Without saved data loadTodos() returns [] - the list is empty and the message is visible.

tests.name: Adding: "  Learn JS  " → the task "Learn JS"
tests.check: (() => { (() => { document.querySelector("#todo-input").value = "  Learn JS  "; const ev = new Event("submit", { bubbles: true, cancelable: true }); document.querySelector("#todo-form").dispatchEvent(ev); return ev; })(); return [...document.querySelectorAll("#todo-list li.todo .todo__title")].map((s) => s.textContent).join("|") === "Learn JS"; })()
tests.fail: A submit handler on the form, the value input.value.trim(), then add, save and render.

tests.name: Submitting does not reload the page
tests.check: (() => { document.querySelector("#todo-input").value = "Learn JS"; const ev = new Event("submit", { bubbles: true, cancelable: true }); document.querySelector("#todo-form").dispatchEvent(ev); return ev; })().defaultPrevented === true
tests.fail: First line of the handler: event.preventDefault();

tests.name: After adding the field is empty and "No tasks yet" is hidden
tests.check: (() => { (() => { document.querySelector("#todo-input").value = "Learn JS"; const ev = new Event("submit", { bubbles: true, cancelable: true }); document.querySelector("#todo-form").dispatchEvent(ev); return ev; })(); return document.querySelector("#todo-input").value === "" && document.querySelector("#todo-empty").hidden === true; })()

tests.name: Tasks are saved in localStorage
tests.check: (() => { (() => { document.querySelector("#todo-input").value = "First"; const ev = new Event("submit", { bubbles: true, cancelable: true }); document.querySelector("#todo-form").dispatchEvent(ev); return ev; })(); (() => { document.querySelector("#todo-input").value = "Second"; const ev = new Event("submit", { bubbles: true, cancelable: true }); document.querySelector("#todo-form").dispatchEvent(ev); return ev; })(); return JSON.stringify(JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("todos"))) === JSON.stringify(["First", "Second"]); })()

tests.name: Empty input: the error "Enter a task", aria-invalid, the task is not added
tests.check: (() => { (() => { document.querySelector("#todo-input").value = "   "; const ev = new Event("submit", { bubbles: true, cancelable: true }); document.querySelector("#todo-form").dispatchEvent(ev); return ev; })(); const e = document.querySelector("#todo-error"); return e.hidden === false && e.textContent === "Enter a task" && document.querySelector("#todo-input").getAttribute("aria-invalid") === "true" && document.querySelectorAll("#todo-list li").length === 0; })()
tests.fail: Check title === "" after trim(); show the error and leave with return.

tests.name: After fixing, the error disappears
tests.check: (() => { (() => { document.querySelector("#todo-input").value = ""; const ev = new Event("submit", { bubbles: true, cancelable: true }); document.querySelector("#todo-form").dispatchEvent(ev); return ev; })(); (() => { document.querySelector("#todo-input").value = "Task"; const ev = new Event("submit", { bubbles: true, cancelable: true }); document.querySelector("#todo-form").dispatchEvent(ev); return ev; })(); return document.querySelector("#todo-error").hidden === true && document.querySelector("#todo-input").getAttribute("aria-invalid") !== "true"; })()
tests.fail: On a successful submit: errorElement.hidden = true; input.removeAttribute("aria-invalid");

tests.name: Saved tasks load on opening
tests.setup: localStorage.setItem("todos", JSON.stringify(["Read the lesson", "Do the task"]));
tests.check: [...document.querySelectorAll("#todo-list li.todo .todo__title")].map((s) => s.textContent).join("|") === "Read the lesson|Do the task" && document.querySelector("#todo-empty").hidden === true
tests.fail: On load: let todos = loadTodos(); renderTodos();

tests.name: Broken data does not break the page
tests.fail: Wrap JSON.parse in try / catch and return [] in catch.

tests.name: A task has a "Delete" button
tests.setup: localStorage.setItem("todos", JSON.stringify(["Read the lesson", "Do the task"]));
tests.check: (() => { const b = document.querySelectorAll("#todo-list li.todo button.todo__delete"); return b.length === 2 && b[0].textContent === "Delete" && b[0].type === "button"; })()
tests.fail: Add <button type="button" class="todo__delete">Delete</button> to every li.

tests.name: Deleting the first task
tests.setup: localStorage.setItem("todos", JSON.stringify(["Read the lesson", "Do the task"]));
tests.check: (() => { document.querySelector("#todo-list .todo__delete").click(); return [...document.querySelectorAll("#todo-list li.todo .todo__title")].map((s) => s.textContent).join("|") === "Do the task" && JSON.stringify(JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("todos"))) === JSON.stringify(["Do the task"]); })()
tests.fail: Remove the task from the array, save and re-render.

tests.name: Deleting all tasks brings back "No tasks yet"
tests.setup: localStorage.setItem("todos", JSON.stringify(["Read the lesson", "Do the task"]));
tests.check: (() => { document.querySelector("#todo-list .todo__delete").click(); document.querySelector("#todo-list .todo__delete").click(); return document.querySelectorAll("#todo-list li").length === 0 && document.querySelector("#todo-empty").hidden === false; })()
tests.fail: After deleting call renderTodos() - it updates the empty-list message.

tests.name: Deleting works after adding (delegation)
tests.check: (() => { (() => { document.querySelector("#todo-input").value = "New"; const ev = new Event("submit", { bubbles: true, cancelable: true }); document.querySelector("#todo-form").dispatchEvent(ev); return ev; })(); document.querySelector("#todo-list .todo__delete").click(); return document.querySelectorAll("#todo-list li").length === 0; })()

tests.name: JSON.parse, JSON.stringify and try / catch are used
tests.fail: localStorage stores strings: JSON.stringify when saving, JSON.parse inside try / catch when reading.

tests.name: The program runs without errors
tests.fail: Read the error text; a common cause is null from a typo in a selector.

hints: Reading: try { const saved = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("todos")); return Array.isArray(saved) ? saved : []; } catch (error) { return []; }
Order: declare the functions first, then let todos = loadTodos(); renderTodos();
First line of the submit handler: event.preventDefault();
Store the task index in the button's data-index; delete with todos.filter((title, i) => i !== index).
After every change of todos: saveTodos(); renderTodos();

questions.question: Which element gets the form submission handler?
questions.explanation: submit catches both a click on the button and Enter in a field.

questions.question: What happens without event.preventDefault() in the submit handler?
options: The form is submitted and the page reloads
questions.explanation: That is the form's default action.

questions.question: What makes a form error message accessible?
options: Text next to the field saying what to fix
Only a red border with no text
questions.explanation: A screen reader cannot read colour without text.

questions.question: What does localStorage.getItem("theme") return if that key was never saved?
questions.explanation: For a missing key getItem returns null.

questions.question: What is saved: localStorage.setItem("count", 5); typeof localStorage.getItem("count")?
Match the method with the result.
questions.explanation: A broken string is read inside try / catch.

questions.question: What must not be stored in localStorage?
questions.explanation: The storage is available to any script on the page.

questions.question: What happens after the catch block?
options: The program continues after try / catch
questions.explanation: catch catches the error and work continues.

questions.question: Which keyword declares a function in which you can use await? Type the word.
questions.explanation: async function loadCourses() { const response = await fetch(...); }

questions.question: The server responded with 404. What does fetch do?
options: Returns a response with ok: false - you have to throw the error yourself
questions.explanation: fetch only throws an error on a network failure.

questions.question: Match the loading state with the text for the user.
pairs: Could not load. Try refreshing the page.
questions.explanation: The user always understands what is happening.

questions.question: A page opened by double-clicking (file://) cannot fetch("data/courses.json"). What should you do?
options: Run a local server, for example Live Server
questions.explanation: The browser blocks requests from file:// pages.
